name: DomainSum
description: DomainSum is a hierarchical benchmark designed to evaluate abstractive summarization models under fine-grained domain shifts categorized into genre, style, and topic. It assesses the domain generalization capabilities of pre-trained and large language models in both in-domain and cross-domain settings.
reputation: A recent arXiv benchmark that is still emerging and has limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Benchmark captures hierarchical domain shifts and evaluates domain generalization of summarization models.
